meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 让 Claude 在 agent 容器里执行 Bash 命令时，先经过 rtk 压缩代理再运行，git、cargo 等开发命令的 token 消耗可降 60–90%，无需额外说明。
howto.when: 安装并重启后，容器内每次 Bash 工具调用都会被 rtk 截获；典型如你让 Claude 跑 git status、docker ps 等命令时自动生效。

howto.what_en: Routes every Bash tool call in the agent container through the rtk proxy after installation, compressing tokens 60–90% for dev commands like git, cargo, pytest, docker, and kubectl.
howto.when_en: After installation and restart, every Bash tool call inside a container triggers rtk; typical cases include running git status, docker ps, or other dev commands.
